technical_and_design_decisions: Implement a friendly name mapping system for chaincode using a metadata store or registry.
Use the existing lifecycle system chaincode (LSCC) to manage deployment policies for chaincodes.
Create documentation for upgrade flows as part of the developer guide.
Implement a 'Solo' ordering service with a single-threaded in-memory ledger for block creation and client seek functionality.
Mirror the Hyperledger Fabric repository to GitHub for public access.
Implement a state cache mechanism to allow quick retrieval of read-write sets for submitters.
Centralize documentation hosting at hyperledger.org for all Hyperledger projects.
Extract peer CLI commands into a standalone component independent of the peer node internals.
assumptions: The development environment is already set up with necessary tools and dependencies.
The team has prior experience with Hyperledger Fabric and Go programming language.
Documentation updates are part of the development effort and do not require separate content creation.
GitHub mirroring is a one-time setup task.
The state cache implementation will use an in-memory data structure for simplicity.
The standalone CLI component will be built using the same language as the peer (Go).
The Solo orderer will not require complex consensus algorithms due to single-process nature.
